name: The Strange Hermit

angles.text: As a druid, you may value the hermit's bond with the local forest spirits, though their songs offer less than the deeper communion you know.
As an engineer, you may understand the comfort the hermit finds in building by hand to furnish his lonely dwelling.

faq.answer: The Strange Hermit is an eccentric, hooded recluse in Shadowgale Forest. Unused to company, he tends his handmade possessions and spends time with local woodland spirits instead of other people.
The hermit lives deep among the trees of Shadowgale Forest, far from towns and trade routes where few travelers pass.
The hermit says he lived somewhere else before choosing to settle in the forest. He keeps his past vague and makes his life among handmade things and the wild spirits of the woods.
faq.q: Why does the hermit live by himself?

faq.answer: The local forest spirits sing to the hermit, though they do not speak with him. He enjoys their songs, but they cannot answer as another person can.
faq.q: Can the hermit speak with forest spirits?

faq.answer: The hermit has made several handcrafted items and structures to occupy himself. He finds comfort and contentment in these simple belongings.
faq.q: What has the hermit built in the forest?

faq.answer: You approach the nervous hermit in Shadowgale Forest and hear what he chooses to share about his life in seclusion.
faq.q: What happens during the quest 'The Strange Hermit'?

sections.body: Deep beneath Shadowgale Forest's canopy, you find a hooded recluse far from towns and trade routes. He is known simply as the Strange Hermit. Years without ordinary company have left him nervous and awkward in conversation. Even a greeting seems strange to him.
sections.title: A Recluse in the Woods

sections.body: The hermit says he has the company and provisions he needs. He once lived elsewhere, then chose a life here among handmade trinkets and the local forest spirits. They often sing to him, though their songs cannot answer him as another person can.
sections.title: Spirits and Simple Things

summary: In Shadowgale Forest, a hooded hermit keeps to himself beneath the trees. Though years alone have made him shy, he shares something of his handmade life and the forest spirits who sing to him.
attribution: In-game quest text: The Strange Hermit
